# The Open Sports Sciences Journal

> Open-access peer-reviewed research platform for sports sciences published by Bentham Open with CC-BY 4.0 licensing and rigorous publication ethics standards.

The Open Sports Sciences Journal is a peer-reviewed open-access publication platform dedicated to advancing sports sciences research. The journal maintains high editorial standards through its international editorial board led by Editor-in-Chief Pantelis T. Nikolaidis, comprehensive ethical guidelines, and commitment to scholarly integrity.

## Journal Overview & Getting Started

- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Home Page](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/): Main homepage featuring featured publications and journal scope in sports sciences
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - About the Journal](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/about-the-journal.php): Journal overview covering scope, indexing, article processing charges, and submission guidelines
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - About The Publisher](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/about-the-publisher.php): Bentham Open publisher profile with CC-BY 4.0 licensing and open access publishing details

## Manuscript Submission & Editorial Process

- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Submit Papers](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/call-for-papers.php): Manuscript submission guidelines and call for papers in sports sciences research
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Editorial Board](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/editorial-board.php): Editorial board listing including Editor-in-Chief Pantelis T. Nikolaidis and international editors
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Editorial Management](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/editorial-management.php): Editorial board structure, editor roles, and journal governance procedures
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Frequently Asked Quesions](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/frequently-asked-questions.php): FAQs covering manuscript submission, peer review, MPS system, and copyright policy

## Publication Ethics & Scholarly Integrity

- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Publishing Ethics and Rectitude](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/publishing-ethics.php): Publishing ethics standards including peer review, author, and reviewer responsibilities
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Research Misconduct](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/research-misconduct.php): Research misconduct procedures and ethics advisory panel complaint handling processes
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Plagiarism Preventation](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/plagiarism-prevention.php): Plagiarism prevention using iThenticate software and academic integrity standards
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Conflict of Interest](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/conflict-of-interest.php): Conflict of interest disclosure requirements and financial disclosure guidelines
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Fabricating and stating false information](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/fabricating-and-stating-false-information.php): Publication ethics policy on data fabrication, retractions, and scholarly integrity
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Allegations From Whistleblowers](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/allegations-from-whistleblowers.php): Whistleblower allegations handling and ethics advisory panel response procedures

## Editorial Policies & Standards

- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Editorial Policies](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/editorial-policies.php): Editorial policies covering open access, licensing, peer review, and preprint policy
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Open Access Policy](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/open-access-policy.php): Open access policy details including CC-BY 4.0 licensing and publication rights
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Post Publication Discussions and Corrections](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/post-publication-discussions-and-corrections.php): Post-publication correction, corrigendum, and retraction procedures per COPE guidelines
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Ensuring Content Integrity](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/ensuring-content-integrity.php): Content integrity assurance using CrossMark and CrossRef article tracking services

## Guidelines & Training

- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Ethical Guidelines for New Editors](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/ethical-guidelines-for-new-editors.php): COPE ethical guidelines and best practices for new journal editors
- [The Open Sports Sciences Journal - Open Url Guidelines](https://opensportssciencesjournal.com/open-url-guidelines.php): Technical documentation for OpenURL linking syntax, DOI parameters, and PDF linking
